It's neither a competition to see who posts what first, nor my style to do something like that even if I had the power to do so (which I don't). It's very likely that your original comment was deleted due to a strict no buying/selling comments rule here on the UWO Database. Try to avoid those in the future and I'm sure things will be fine.
